correctness.rationale: The model admits a unique stationary Gaussian stochastic-convolution representation. The auxiliary exponentially weighted occupation process has an exact Beta(k/(2 gamma),k/(2 gamma)) law by stationary two-state flux equations; conditional Gaussianity yields the moment identities. Standardized fourth beta moment increases strictly with its positive shape parameter, giving a unique inverse and exact strict positivity constraints. A constructive continuum and two exact rational parameter triples prove order-six nonidentifiability. The published forward entropy-production expression is substituted algebraically. A packaged standard-library script separately calculates the two-state transport and coupled diffusion moment recurrences and passed 114 rational assertions, without being used as a substitute for the global proof.

value.rationale: The natural hidden-parameter inference problem for the published thermodynamic system has an exact observation threshold: one-time stationary moments of order at most six cannot identify the switching frequency or energy dissipation, whereas orders two, four and eight completely identify both. The exact feasible-data inequalities and explicit inverse provide diagnostic and physical interpretation beyond recomputing a forward moment table. A pair of positive models with the same low moments but distinct dissipation demonstrates substantive rather than merely computational value.
